div.p: NCAA Division I athletics, 2,000+ intramural participants, and world-class facilities — because being an Axion Storm means more than just showing up to class.
Axion competes at the NCAA Division I level as a proud member of the Atlantic Collegiate Conference (ACC). Our 24 varsity programs are committed to excellence on and off the field.

div.div: Back-to-back conference champions, advancing to the NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 for the first time in program history.
Men's team claimed the conference championship; three swimmers earned All-American honors at the NCAA Championships.
16 programs earned ACC Academic Honor Roll. 92% four-year graduation rate — among the best in Division I.

div.p: You don't have to be a varsity athlete to compete. Over 2,000 students participate in intramural leagues and club sports every semester.

div.div: How to Join: Register on the Axion Recreation Portal each semester. Intramural registration opens two weeks before the season. Club sports hold tryouts / open practices at the start of fall and spring terms.

div.p: 7,500-seat multi-purpose arena for basketball, volleyball, and major campus events. Renovated 2022 with modern video boards and expanded seating.
Open to all students. Features 3 NBA-size courts, Olympic pool, fitness center with 200+ machines, racquetball, and indoor track.
NCAA-standard 50-meter competition pool plus a separate diving well with 1m and 3m boards. Home to the championship swim and dive programs.
Natural-grass soccer and lacrosse fields plus a synthetic-turf practice field. 3,000-seat grandstand with lights for evening matches.
400m all-weather track with field event areas plus an adjacent 2,200-seat baseball stadium with a modern press box and locker facilities.
12 outdoor courts plus 4 indoor courts. Varsity courts include stadium seating for up to 500 spectators. Open for student recreation when not in varsity use.
